name: column.category_code.boosting
chosen_by: out-of-fold accuracy over 5 folds grouped by table; best boosting:1.0
calibration: Platt scaling on the same 5 table-grouped folds of the training rows
limits: Measured on dev rows; the sealed partition is read once, under 22.3's gate.
Trained on generated tables (22.1): it learns these planted kinds, not real tables.
A group is a base and a seed: dev holds new seeds of the same bases as training, not new kinds of table, so dev measures reading planted kinds in tables like those trained on.
Every generated table plants the same kinds, so intervals drawn by table group are narrow: they say how stable the model is across these tables, not across other kinds of table.
